sections.label: The opening
sections.line: RiskMandate's strategy: a spectrum of trust we walk with each customer.
sections.para: How do we engage a customer, earn their trust and become a player running our code and vaults with them? Five stages, each answering the next question: policies, understand, risk acceptance, contain, manage. Acceleration runs through all of them; insurance comes after, as a future decision. Other players lead each stage. We are in the first.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Seven points: the strategy, five stages, acceleration, insurance, where we are.
sections.para: This is RiskMandate's strategy and the path we walk with each customer, each stage earning more trust. Policies first, a microcosm of what we do. Then understand the exposure, then risk acceptance, then contain and manage. Acceleration runs through all of it; insurance comes after, as a future decision. We are in the first stage, with our first customers.

sections.label: A spectrum of trust
sections.para: The strategy answers how we start engaging a customer, earn their trust and become a player, running our code and vaults with them. Each stage answers a different question the customer has, asked only once the one before is answered. The deeper along, the deeper the relationship. A sequence of events, not always a straight line.

sections.label: The five stages
sections.line: The five stages, and the customer's question at each.
sections.para: Policies: what can this agent do, and what stops it; a microcosm we can offer today. Understand: what is our exposure, where are the agents and what can they reach. Risk acceptance: which risks we carry, and who decides. Contain: a smaller blast radius, rules out of reach. Manage: the agents run as a fleet, strategically.

sections.label: Accelerate, all the way through
sections.para: Accelerate was a stage after manage, and it is not one. Every stage lets the business do more with its agents, with more confidence and faster, so acceleration is the reason for the roadmap rather than a step on it.

sections.label: Insurance, and the players at every stage
sections.line: Insurance, and the players at every stage.
sections.para: After manage, the evidence an insurer needs exists; whether we play in insurance or work with those who do is a future decision. Every stage has companies that should be its big players, many of whom we will work with; where they do not move fast enough, there is an opportunity for us, already beside the customer.

sections.label: Where we are: the policies
sections.line: Where we are: the policies, with our first customers.
sections.para: Stage one is sorting out the policies and their flows, through the first customers' site at customers.riskmandate.ai. Its seven milestone steps follow the first stage, from credit and one named agent to the usage moment. At v0.1.1 it counts three customers, two started, 3 of 21 steps done, no first policy yet and no credit used.

sections.label: A side note: the policy and its home
sections.line: A side note: the policy and its home.
sections.para: The Agent Behaviour Policy's stewardship moves to the Open Security Summit as its first hosted project; RiskMandate still operates it with customers. The policies are a stepping stone: behaviour, then decision and workflow policies, on the way to being trusted with a customer's agents from the first policy to the managed fleet.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.para: The stages are a sequence, not a schedule, with no dates, and may overlap. Only the first is under way. Insurance is a future decision. The other players are not named. The counts are the customer site's own, read on 20 October 2026.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.para: Two voice memos of 20 October 2026; RiskMandate's licence to operate and insurance pages; and customers.riskmandate.ai at v0.1.1, its home page and milestones.
